verdict: Leads are up sharply, but none are moving through your intake pipeline.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta campaign delivered 139 leads at $12.85 per lead — a 16.4% drop in cost per lead alongside a nearly 30% surge in lead volume week-over-week, the strongest efficiency this campaign has seen. The issue is what happens after a lead arrives: your CRM shows 122 contacts received and zero opportunities created, meaning leads are coming in but not being tracked or advanced toward cases. Two tools needed to close that gap — SMS automation and call access — are still pending setup, and getting those live is the immediate priority. Once intake is connected, the scale-or-cut decision planned for end of October will have real case data to work from.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, the highest volume in the tracked window
cost per lead this period, down 16.4% from the prior week
opportunities created from 122 contacts — the pipeline gap being addressed now

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but not moving through intake — 122 contacts, zero opportunities logged in the CRM.
watch_item.fix: SMS automation and call routing are being activated now to close the gap before any further spend scales.
